teacher.name: Siti Rahmawati, S.Pd.
teacher.subject: Bahasa Inggris
teacher.bio: Guru Bahasa Inggris SMP dengan pengalaman 10 tahun. Mengembangkan pembelajaran interaktif, komunikatif, dan berbasis AI untuk memupuk kepercayaan diri peserta didik dalam berbahasa Inggris.

modules.title: Modul Demonstrasi Resmi: Introducing Yourself
modules.description: Modul percontohan kurikulum merdeka Kelas VII SMP untuk melatih keberanian siswa menyapa, memperkenalkan diri dan teman, serta menutup percakapan dengan sopan dan natural.

sections.title: 1. Greetings (Salam Pembuka)
sections.content: Salam pembuka digunakan saat pertama kali bertemu seseorang. Perhatikan waktu penggunaannya:

dialogue.speaker: Edo
dialogue.textEn: Good morning, Mr. Ahmad! How are you today?
dialogue.textId: Selamat pagi, Pak Ahmad! Bagaimana kabar Bapak hari ini?

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Ahmad
dialogue.textEn: Good morning, Edo. I am very well, thank you. And you?
dialogue.textId: Selamat pagi, Edo. Bapak sangat baik, terima kasih. Bagaimana denganmu?

dialogue.speaker: Edo
dialogue.textEn: I am fine too, Sir.
dialogue.textId: Saya juga baik-baik saja, Pak.

sections.audioScript: Good morning. How are you today? I am fine, thank you.

sections.title: 2. Introducing Yourself (Memperkenalkan Diri Sendiri)
sections.content: Untuk memperkenalkan diri, sebutkan nama, usia, asal sekolah, dan hal singkat tentang dirimu. Gunakan kalimat yang jelas dan percaya diri.

dialogue.speaker: Siti
dialogue.textEn: Hello everyone! My name is Siti Rahma. You can call me Siti.
dialogue.textId: Halo semuanya! Nama saya Siti Rahma. Kalian bisa memanggil saya Siti.

dialogue.speaker: Siti
dialogue.textEn: I am thirteen years old. I am a student of SMP Negeri 1.
dialogue.textId: Saya berusia tiga belas tahun. Saya adalah siswa SMP Negeri 1.

dialogue.speaker: Class
dialogue.textEn: Nice to meet you, Siti!
dialogue.textId: Senang berkenalan denganmu, Siti!

sections.audioScript: Hello, my name is Siti Rahma. I am thirteen years old. Nice to meet you.

sections.title: 3. Asking Someone’s Name (Menanyakan Nama Orang Lain)
sections.content: Tanyakan nama lawan bicara dengan sopan:

dialogue.speaker: Andi
dialogue.textEn: Excuse me, what is your name?
dialogue.textId: Permisi, siapa namamu?

dialogue.speaker: Budi
dialogue.textEn: My name is Budi. And yours?
dialogue.textId: Nama saya Budi. Dan namamu?

dialogue.speaker: Andi
dialogue.textEn: I am Andi. May I know your nickname?
dialogue.textId: Saya Andi. Bolehkah saya tahu nama panggilanmu?

dialogue.speaker: Budi
dialogue.textEn: You can call me Bud.
dialogue.textId: Kamu bisa memanggil saya Bud.

sections.audioScript: Excuse me, what is your name? My name is Budi. Nice to meet you.

sections.title: 4. Asking Where Someone Lives (Menanyakan Tempat Tinggal)
sections.content: Gunakan preposisi yang tepat: "in" untuk kota/desa (in Sukamaju), "on" untuk nama jalan (on Jl. Merdeka), "at" untuk alamat lengkap beserta nomor rumah (at Jl. Merdeka No. 5).

dialogue.speaker: Rani
dialogue.textEn: Where do you live, Andi?
dialogue.textId: Di mana kamu tinggal, Andi?

dialogue.speaker: Andi
dialogue.textEn: I live in a small village called Melati Village.
dialogue.textId: Saya tinggal di sebuah desa kecil bernama Desa Melati.

dialogue.speaker: Rani
dialogue.textEn: Do you live on Melati Street?
dialogue.textId: Apakah kamu tinggal di Jalan Melati?

dialogue.speaker: Andi
dialogue.textEn: Yes, I live at Melati Street Number 12.
dialogue.textId: Ya, saya tinggal di Jalan Melati Nomor 12.

sections.audioScript: Where do you live? I live in a quiet village. It is green and peaceful.

sections.title: 5. Asking About Hobbies (Menanyakan Kegemaran)
sections.content: Membicarakan hobi membuat percakapan terasa hangat dan bersahabat. Pola kalimat: "My hobby is [verb-ing]" atau "I like [verb-ing]".

dialogue.speaker: Bayu
dialogue.textEn: What is your hobby, Dika?
dialogue.textId: Apa hobimu, Dika?

dialogue.speaker: Dika
dialogue.textEn: I love playing badminton and reading comic books. What about you?
dialogue.textId: Saya suka bermain bulu tangkis dan membaca buku komik. Bagaimana denganmu?

dialogue.speaker: Bayu
dialogue.textEn: My hobby is cycling. I cycle to school every morning!
dialogue.textId: Hobiku bersepeda. Saya bersepeda ke sekolah setiap pagi!

sections.audioScript: What is your hobby? My hobby is playing badminton and cycling.

sections.title: 6. Introducing a Friend (Memperkenalkan Teman)
sections.content: Perkenalkan temanmu kepada orang lain dengan ungkapan: "This is my friend, [Nama]..." atau "I would like you to meet..."

dialogue.speaker: Siti
dialogue.textEn: Andi, this is my classmate, Dewi.
dialogue.textId: Andi, ini teman sekelasku, Dewi.

dialogue.speaker: Andi
dialogue.textEn: Hi, Dewi! Glad to meet you.
dialogue.textId: Hai, Dewi! Senang bertemu denganmu.

dialogue.speaker: Dewi
dialogue.textEn: Glad to meet you too, Andi! Siti told me a lot about you.
dialogue.textId: Senang bertemu denganmu juga, Andi! Siti banyak bercerita tentangmu.

sections.audioScript: This is my friend Dewi. She is a cheerful classmate. Glad to meet you.

sections.title: 7. Closing a Conversation (Menutup Percakapan)
sections.content: Akhiri percakapan dengan salam perpisahan yang ramah dan sopan:

dialogue.speaker: Rian
dialogue.textEn: It was nice talking to you, Andi, but the bell is ringing.
dialogue.textId: Senang mengobrol denganmu, Andi, tapi bel sudah berbunyi.

dialogue.speaker: Andi
dialogue.textEn: Sure! Let us go to the classroom. See you later!
dialogue.textId: Tentu! Mari kita ke ruang kelas. Sampai jumpa lagi!

dialogue.speaker: Rian
dialogue.textEn: See you! Have a great day!
dialogue.textId: Sampai jumpa! Semoga harimu menyenangkan!

sections.audioScript: It was nice talking to you. See you later! Have a great day!

modules.title: Modul Kelas VIII: Descriptive Text & My Daily Routine
modules.description: Mendeskripsikan orang, hewan, tempat wisata, serta menceritakan rutinitas harian dengan Simple Present Tense yang tepat.

sections.title: Describing My Beloved School
sections.content: Descriptive text bertujuan menggambarkan objek secara spesifik. Struktur teks: Identification (pengenalan) dan Description (karakteristik fisik dan sifat).
sections.audioScript: My school is clean and beautiful. There is a wide field with tall green trees.

modules.title: Modul Kelas IX: Procedure Text & Past Experiences
modules.description: Menuliskan resep, petunjuk manual langkah demi langkah (Goal, Materials, Steps), serta berbagi pengalaman liburan lampau.

sections.title: How to Make Delicious Fried Rice
sections.content: Procedure text menggunakan kata kerja tindakan (action verbs) seperti stir, fry, chop, serta kata urutan waktu (first, next, then, finally).
sections.audioScript: First, heat the cooking oil. Then add chopped garlic and shallots. Stir well.

vocabulary.exampleEn: A warm greeting makes people smile.
vocabulary.exampleId: Sapaan yang hangat membuat orang tersenyum.

vocabulary.exampleEn: Let me introduce myself to the new class.
vocabulary.exampleId: Izinkan saya memperkenalkan diri kepada kelas baru.

vocabulary.exampleEn: It is a pleasure to meet you here.
vocabulary.exampleId: Merupakan kesenangan bertemu dengan Anda di sini.

vocabulary.exampleEn: Budi is my favorite classmate in grade seven.
vocabulary.exampleId: Budi adalah teman sekelas favoritku di kelas tujuh.

vocabulary.exampleEn: My full name is Muhammad Rizky, but my nickname is Kiki.
vocabulary.exampleId: Nama lengkap saya Muhammad Rizky, tapi nama panggilan saya Kiki.

vocabulary.exampleEn: She speaks English with great courage.

vocabulary.exampleEn: Practice gives you confidence to speak in public.
vocabulary.exampleId: Latihan memberimu kepercayaan diri untuk berbicara di depan umum.

vocabulary.exampleEn: Always give a polite answer when someone asks for help.

grammarTopics.title: Subject Pronouns
grammarTopics.titleId: Kata Ganti Subjek (I, You, They, We, He, She, It)
grammarTopics.summary: Kata ganti yang berfungsi sebagai pelaku aksi dalam sebuah kalimat.
grammarTopics.explanation:
Subject pronoun menggantikan nama orang atau benda agar kalimat tidak berulang-ulang. Ingat pasangan subjek:
- I (Saya)
- You (Kamu/Kalian)
- They (Mereka - jamak)
- We (Kita/Kami)
- He (Dia laki-laki tunggal)
- She (Dia perempuan tunggal)
- It (Benda / hewan tunggal)

examples.en: I am a junior high school student.
He lives in Sukamaju Village.
They play football every Sunday.
examples.id: Mereka bermain sepak bola setiap hari Minggu.

commonMistakes.wrong: Me go to school with Budi.
commonMistakes.right: I go to school with Budi.
commonMistakes.explanation: "Me" adalah object pronoun. Untuk subjek kalimat, selalu gunakan "I".
"Her" adalah kata ganti kepunyaan atau objek. Gunakan "She" untuk subjek perempuan tunggal.

exercises.question: ___ is my older brother. His name is Rian.
exercises.explanation: Rian adalah laki-laki dan posisinya sebagai subjek kalimat, sehingga kata ganti yang tepat adalah "He".

exercises.question: Andi and I are classmates. ___ study English together.
exercises.explanation: "Andi and I" mencakup diri pembicara (kami/kita), sehingga kata ganti subjeknya adalah "We".

grammarTopics.title: To Be: Am, Is, Are
grammarTopics.titleId: Kata Kerja Bantu: Am, Is, Are
grammarTopics.summary: Kata kerja penghubung untuk menyatakan keadaan, identitas, sifat, atau lokasi pada masa sekarang.
grammarTopics.formula: Subject + To Be (am/is/are) + Adjective / Noun / Adverb
grammarTopics.explanation:
Aturan memasangkan To Be dengan Subjek:
- I -> am
- He / She / It / Nama Tunggal -> is
- You / They / We / Jamak -> are

examples.en: I am proud of my school.
She is a talented singer.
We are ready to learn.

commonMistakes.explanation: "They" adalah jamak, jadi harus dipasangkan dengan "are", bukan "is".

exercises.question: The students ___ in the school library right now.
exercises.explanation: "The students" berakhiran -s (jamak/plural), maka to be yang tepat adalah "are".

grammarTopics.title: Simple Present Tense
grammarTopics.summary: Digunakan untuk menceritakan rutinitas sehari-hari, kebiasaan, dan fakta umum.
grammarTopics.formula:
(+) S + V1 (-s/-es untuk He/She/It)
(-) S + do/does not + V1
(?) Do/Does + S + V1?
grammarTopics.explanation:
Perhatikan penambahan -s atau -es jika subjeknya orang ketiga tunggal (He, She, It, nama satu orang):
- He plays badminton.
- She washes the dishes.
Untuk subjek I, You, They, We, gunakan kata kerja dasar tanpa akhiran (They play).

examples.en: The sun rises in the east.
Dewi reads a book every night.
They do not drink coffee.

commonMistakes.explanation: Karena subjeknya "He" (tunggal), tambahkan -s pada kata kerja dasar: "plays".

commonMistakes.wrong: She does not likes spicy food.
commonMistakes.right: She does not like spicy food.
commonMistakes.explanation: Setelah kata bantu "does not", kata kerja kembali ke bentuk dasar: "like".

exercises.question: My mother ___ delicious fried rice every Sunday morning.
exercises.explanation: "My mother" adalah She (orang ketiga tunggal), sehingga kata kerjanya ditambah -s menjadi "cooks".

grammarTopics.title: Present Continuous Tense
grammarTopics.summary: Menyatakan aksi yang sedang berlangsung tepat saat kita berbicara.
grammarTopics.explanation: Keterangan waktu yang sering digunakan: now, right now, at the moment, look!, listen!

examples.en: Listen! The teacher is speaking.
We are learning English together.
examples.id: Kita sedang belajar Bahasa Inggris bersama-sama.

commonMistakes.explanation: Jangan lupa memasang to be (am/is/are) sebelum Verb-ing.

exercises.question: Look! The birds ___ in the bright blue sky.
exercises.explanation: "The birds" jamak, to be yang sesuai adalah "are" diikuti verb-ing: "are flying".

grammarTopics.title: Simple Past Tense
grammarTopics.summary: Digunakan untuk menyatakan peristiwa yang sudah selesai di masa lalu.
grammarTopics.formula:
(+) S + V2
(-) S + did not + V1
(?) Did + S + V1?
grammarTopics.explanation: Kata kerja bentuk kedua (V2) terbagi menjadi regular verbs (tambah -ed seperti visited, walked) dan irregular verbs (went, saw, ate).

examples.en: Yesterday, I visited my grandparents.
We went to Bali last holiday.
examples.id: Kami pergi ke Bali liburan lalu.

commonMistakes.wrong: I did not went to school yesterday.
commonMistakes.right: I did not go to school yesterday.
commonMistakes.explanation: Setelah kata "did not", kata kerja kembali ke bentuk pertama (V1: "go").

exercises.question: Last week, Andi and his father ___ fresh fish in the river.
exercises.explanation: "Last week" menunjukkan masa lampau, bentuk V2 dari catch adalah "caught".

grammarTopics.title: Personal Information & Questions
grammarTopics.summary: Menggunakan kata tanya What, Where, When, Who, Why, How untuk menanyakan informasi pribadi.
grammarTopics.explanation:
- What (Apa - menanyakan nama, benda)
- Where (Di mana - tempat)
- When (Kapan - waktu)
- Who (Siapa - orang)
- How (Bagaimana - cara, keadaan)

examples.en: What is your hobby?
Where do you come from?

commonMistakes.explanation: Pada Simple Present Tense, kalimat tanya butuh auxiliary do/does.

exercises.question: ___ old are you? I am thirteen years old.
exercises.explanation: Untuk menanyakan usia, gunakan frasa "How old".

grammarTopics.title: Descriptive Text Structure
grammarTopics.summary: Struktur teks untuk mendeskripsikan ciri-ciri khusus orang, binatang, atau benda.
grammarTopics.explanation: Teks deskriptif menggunakan Simple Present Tense dan kata sifat (adjectives) yang kaya seperti beautiful, friendly, tall, colorful.

examples.en: My cat, Miko, has white soft fur and sharp green eyes.
examples.id: Kucingku, Miko, memiliki bulu putih lembut dan mata hijau yang tajam.

commonMistakes.wrong: Using past tense to describe current physical characteristics.
commonMistakes.right: Use simple present tense for general facts and descriptions.
commonMistakes.explanation: Gunakan Simple Present Tense saat mendeskripsikan ciri fisik saat ini.

exercises.question: Which sentence best fits the "Description" part of a descriptive text?
options: I have a lovely rabbit named Snow.
Snow loves carrots and hops happily around the garden.
Once upon a time there was a rabbit.
exercises.explanation: Pilihan B mendeskripsikan makanan kesukaan dan tingkah laku spesifik objek.

grammarTopics.title: Procedure Text Structure
grammarTopics.summary: Teks yang menjelaskan langkah-langkah membuat atau mengoperasikan sesuatu.
grammarTopics.formula:
1. Goal / Aim (Tujuan)
2. Materials / Ingredients (Alat dan Bahan)
3. Steps / Methods (Langkah-langkah)
grammarTopics.explanation: Gunakan kalimat perintah (imperative sentence) seperti: "Boil the water", "Cut the mango", dan connective words (First, Next, Then, Finally).

examples.en: First, wash your hands with clean water and soap.
examples.id: Pertama, cuci tanganmu dengan air bersih dan sabun.

commonMistakes.explanation: Langkah teks prosedur memakai kata kerja imperatif langsung.

exercises.question: ___, pour the hot water into the glass with tea bag.
exercises.explanation: "First" adalah kata penghubung sekuensial yang menandai langkah pertama prosedur.

grammarTopics.title: Pronouns (Object & Possessive)
grammarTopics.summary: Membedakan me, him, her, us, them (objek) dengan my, your, his, their (kepunyaan).
grammarTopics.formula: Possessive Adjective + Noun | Verb + Object Pronoun
grammarTopics.explanation:
- I -> me -> my (buku saya = my book)
- You -> you -> your (temanmu = your friend)
- He -> him -> his (topinya = his cap)
- She -> her -> her (sepatunya = her shoes)
- They -> them -> their (rumah mereka = their house)
- We -> us -> our (kelas kita = our classroom)

examples.en: This is my classroom, and our teacher is very kind.
examples.id: Ini adalah ruang kelasku, dan guru kami sangat baik.

examples.en: Can you help me, please?

exercises.question: Dewi lost ___ pencil case yesterday.
exercises.explanation: "her" adalah kata sifat kepunyaan untuk perempuan tunggal sebelum kata benda "pencil case".

grammarTopics.title: Prepositions of Place & Time
grammarTopics.titleId: Kata Depan Tempat dan Waktu (In, On, At)
grammarTopics.summary: Menggunakan in, on, dan at secara tepat untuk alamat, tempat, dan waktu.
grammarTopics.explanation:
Tempat:
- In: in Indonesia, in Bandung, in a village
- On: on Merdeka Street, on the table
- At: at Jl. Sudirman No. 10, at school, at home
Waktu:
- In: in the morning, in 2026, in July
- On: on Monday, on August 17th
- At: at 7 o’clock, at noon, at night

examples.en: The flag ceremony starts at 7 o’clock.
examples.id: Upacara bendera dimulai pada pukul 7 tepat.

examples.en: I was born in October.

grammarTopics.title: Modal Verbs (Can, Must, Should)
grammarTopics.titleId: Kata Kerja Bantu Modal: Kemampuan, Keharusan, Saran
grammarTopics.explanation:
- Can = bisa / mampu (I can speak English)
- Must = harus / wajib (We must wear uniform)
- Should = sebaiknya / saran (You should study diligently)

examples.en: Students must obey the school rules.
You should drink enough water every day.
examples.id: Kamu sebaiknya minum cukup air setiap hari.

commonMistakes.explanation: Setelah modal verb seperti "can", kata kerja tidak boleh ditambah -s meskipun subjeknya He.

exercises.question: You look tired. You ___ take a rest.
exercises.explanation: "should" digunakan untuk memberikan anjuran atau saran bersahabat.

grammarTopics.title: Comparative and Superlative
grammarTopics.summary: Membandingkan sifat dua benda (Comparative: -er / more) atau lebih dari dua benda (Superlative: -est / most).
grammarTopics.formula:
Comparative: Adjective-er + than / more + Adjective + than
Superlative: the + Adjective-est / the most + Adjective
grammarTopics.explanation:
Satu suku kata:
- tall -> taller than -> the tallest
Dua suku kata atau lebih:
- beautiful -> more beautiful than -> the most beautiful

examples.en: Mount Bromo is colder than Jakarta.
examples.id: Gunung Bromo lebih dingin daripada Jakarta.

examples.en: Dewi is the smartest student in our class.
examples.id: Dewi adalah siswa terpintar di kelas kami.

commonMistakes.wrong: He is more taller than me.
commonMistakes.explanation: Jangan menggabungkan "more" dengan akhiran "-er" secara bersamaan.

exercises.question: An airplane is ___ than a train.
exercises.explanation: Membandingkan dua hal dengan kata sifat satu suku kata menggunakan "-er than": "faster".

pronunciationItems.tip: Tekankan pada suku kata kedua: hel-LO.
Ucapkan bunyi "ea" panjang seperti /iː/ dan akhiri dengan /tʃər/ yang bersih.
Mulai langsung dari huruf S tanpa menambahkan huruf "e" di depannya (bukan eskul).
Gigi atas menyentuh bibir bawah untuk bunyi /v/, lalu akhiri dengan bunyi /dʒ/ lembut.
Tiga suku kata: byu-ti-ful. Tekanan di awal kata.
Ujung lidah di antara gigi atas dan bawah untuk membunyikan "th" (/θ/).
Ucapkan mengalir dengan intonasi ramah dan ceria.
Intonasi turun di akhir kalimat tanya WH-Question.

readingExercises.title: A New Friend in Class 7A
readingExercises.passage:
Today is Monday. It is the first day of the new semester at SMP Negeri 1. A new student named Farhan enters Class 7A. 
Farhan stands in front of the classroom with a bright smile. He says, "Good morning, friends! My name is Farhan Pratama. You can call me Farhan. I am thirteen years old. I moved here from a quiet village in West Java because my father works in this town. My hobby is playing badminton and my dream is to be an athlete. Nice to meet all of you!"
All the students in Class 7A clap their hands warmly. Andi, the class captain, welcomes Farhan with enthusiasm. Farhan feels very happy and confident.

questions.question: What is the main topic of the passage?
options: A new student introducing himself to the class
The daily schedule of SMP Negeri 1
questions.explanation: Teks menceritakan Farhan, siswa baru di kelas 7A, yang memperkenalkan dirinya di depan kelas.

questions.question: Why did Farhan move to the town?
options: Because he won a badminton cup
Because his father works in this town
Because he wanted to visit his grandparents
Because the village school was closed
questions.explanation: Tertulis dalam paragraf kedua: "...because my father works in this town."

questions.question: What is Farhan’s hobby and dream?
options: Reading books and being a doctor
Playing badminton and being an athlete
questions.explanation: Farhan menyatakan: "My hobby is playing badminton and my dream is to be an athlete."

readingExercises.title: Describing My Beloved English Corner
readingExercises.passage:
Our school has a special room called the English Corner. It is located on the second floor next to the library. The room is painted light blue, which makes it feel calm and fresh.
Inside the English Corner, there are colorful bookshelves full of English storybooks, comic magazines, and bilingual dictionaries. In the center of the room, there are comfortable beanbags where students can sit and read. On the walls, we hang posters about English grammar tips, inspiring quotes, and famous world landmarks.
Every Wednesday afternoon, the English Club holds speaking games here. It is our favorite place to practice English without fear of making mistakes.

questions.question: Where is the English Corner located?
options: On the second floor next to the library
questions.explanation: Sesuai kalimat kedua: "It is located on the second floor next to the library."

listeningExercises.title: Listening Practice: Meeting at the Canteen
listeningExercises.audioScript:
Hello! My name is Sarah. I am twelve years old. During the break time, I go to the school canteen with my friend Riko. 
Sarah: Good morning, Mrs. Tina! May I have one bowl of chicken noodle and one glass of iced tea, please?
Mrs. Tina: Good morning, Sarah. Sure! That will be fifteen thousand rupiahs.
Sarah: Here is the money. Thank you very much!
Mrs. Tina: You are welcome, Sarah. Enjoy your meal!

questions.question: What does Sarah order at the school canteen?
questions.explanation: Sarah memesan: "one bowl of chicken noodle and one glass of iced tea".

questions.question: How much does Sarah pay for her order?
questions.explanation: Ibu kantin menyebutkan: "That will be fifteen thousand rupiahs."

writingTasks.title: Menulis Perkenalan Diri (Introducing Yourself)
writingTasks.prompt: Tulis satu paragraf perkenalan diri dalam Bahasa Inggris (minimal 40 kata). Ceritakan nama lengkap, nama panggilan, usia, asal sekolah, tempat tinggal, hobi, dan cita-citamu.
guideQuestions: What is your full name and nickname?
How old are you and where do you go to school?
What is your favorite hobby and why do you like it?
What is your dream in the future?

writingTasks.title: Menulis Deskripsi Tempat Tinggal (My Village or Town)
writingTasks.prompt: Gambarkan desa atau lingkungan tempat tinggalmu dalam 50-70 kata. Jelaskan apa yang membuat tempat tersebut istimewa (suasana, pemandangan, atau keramahan warganya).
guideQuestions: What is the name of your village or town?
What does it look like? (peaceful, crowded, green)
What do you like most about your neighborhood?

writingSubmissions.content: Hello everyone! My name is Andi Pratama. You can call me Andi. I am thirteen years old. I am a student at SMP Negeri 1. I live in Melati Village with my family. My village is green and peaceful. My hobby is playing badminton every afternoon with my friends. In the future, I want to be a teacher because I love helping people learn.

strengths: Penggunaan to be dan kalimat Simple Present Tense sudah sangat akurat.
Pilihan kosakata sesuai konteks siswa SMP (green and peaceful, helping people learn).
Alur paragraf runut dari sapaan hingga penutup.
improvements: Dapat menambahkan variasi penghubung kalimat seperti "Besides that," atau "Moreover,".
aiFeedback.sampleCorrection: Hello everyone! My name is Andi Pratama, and you can call me Andi. I am thirteen years old and study at SMP Negeri 1. I live in Melati Village, which is green and peaceful. My hobby is playing badminton every afternoon with my friends. In the future, my dream is to become a teacher because I love helping others learn.
aiFeedback.detailedNotes: Tulisan Andi memenuhi semua kriteria tugas perkenalan diri dengan sangat memuaskan.

writingSubmissions.teacherComment: Luar biasa, Andi! Kalimatmu sangat rapi dan percaya diri. Terus berlatih ya!

quizzes.title: Evaluasi Awal (Pre-Test): Kemampuan Dasar Bahasa Inggris Kelas VII

questions.questionText: When you meet your teacher at 07.00 a.m., what greeting should you say?
questions.explanation: Pukul 07.00 pagi menggunakan salam "Good morning".

questions.questionText: Farhan: "What is your name?" - Budi: "___ name is Budi."
questions.explanation: Budi menjawab untuk dirinya sendiri, jadi kata sifat kepunyaan yang tepat adalah "My".

questions.questionText: Is the sentence "She are a doctor" grammatically correct?
questions.explanation: Salah. Subjek tunggal "She" harus berpasangan dengan "is" (She is a doctor).

questions.questionText: Lengkapilah kalimat: "Where ___ you live?" (Gunakan kata bantu do/does)
questions.explanation: Subjek "you" menggunakan kata bantu "do" dalam kalimat tanya Simple Present.

questions.questionText: Susunlah kata-kata acak berikut menjadi kalimat yang benar: [to / Nice / meet / you]
questions.explanation: Susunan yang benar adalah ungkapan perkenalan: "Nice to meet you".

quizzes.title: Evaluasi Akhir (Post-Test): Modul Introducing Yourself Kelas VII

questions.questionText: Andi: "Hello Dewi, this is my friend Budi." - Dewi: "Hi Budi, ___"
questions.explanation: Saat diperkenalkan kepada teman baru, respons yang sopan dan tepat adalah "Glad to meet you" atau "Nice to meet you".

questions.questionText: Which preposition is correct for a specific street address with house number? "I live ___ Melati Street No. 12."
questions.explanation: Alamat lengkap beserta nomor rumah menggunakan preposisi "at".

questions.questionText: Complete the sentence: "My sister ___ (like) reading story books."
questions.explanation: Subjek "My sister" (She) memerlukan penambahan -s pada kata kerja Simple Present Tense: "likes".

questions.questionText: Jodohkan ungkapan Bahasa Inggris dengan maknanya dalam Bahasa Indonesia:
questions.correctAnswer: Good morning:Selamat pagi|See you later:Sampai jumpa lagi|Excuse me:Permisi
questions.explanation: Pasangan arti kata baku dalam percakapan sehari-hari.

questions.questionText: Susunlah kata-kata berikut: [is / hobby / My / football / playing]
questions.explanation: Struktur yang tepat: My hobby + is + playing football.

quizzes.title: Ujian Standar Komprehensif Bahasa Inggris SMP (50 Nomor: 40 Pilihan Ganda & 10 Essai)
quizzes.topic: Evaluasi Standar Lengkap (Grammar, Vocabulary, Reading, Speaking & Writing)

questions.questionText: When you meet your teacher at the school gate at 06:45 a.m., what is the best greeting to say?
questions.explanation: Pukul 06.45 pagi menggunakan salam "Good morning".

questions.questionText: Complete the dialogue: Rian: "Hi Maya, how are you today?" - Maya: "___"
options: I am fine, thank you. And you?
questions.explanation: Jawaban yang tepat untuk menanyakan kabar "How are you today?" adalah "I am fine, thank you. And you?".

questions.questionText: Complete the sentence: "Hello, my name ___ Farhan and I am in Grade VII."
questions.explanation: Subjek "my name" adalah kata benda tunggal (it), sehingga menggunakan to be "is".

questions.questionText: Andi: "Dewi, this is my classmate, Budi." - Dewi: "Hello Budi, ___"
questions.explanation: Saat diperkenalkan kepada orang baru, respons kesantunan yang tepat adalah "Glad to meet you" atau "Nice to meet you".

questions.questionText: Which pronoun correctly replaces the underlined words? "Siti and Rahma practice speaking English together every day."
questions.explanation: Subjek jamak orang ketiga "Siti and Rahma" digantikan dengan pronoun "They".

questions.questionText: Which preposition is used for specific pinpoint street address with house number? "Rani lives ___ Diponegoro Street No. 24."
questions.explanation: Alamat spesifik yang mencantumkan nomor rumah menggunakan preposisi "at".

questions.questionText: Choose the correct Simple Present sentence with subject "She":
options: She studies English diligently every night.
She study English diligently every night.
She is study English diligently every night.
She studying English diligently every night.
questions.explanation: Subjek orang ketiga tunggal "She" memerlukan penambahan akhiran -ies pada kata kerja "study" -> "studies".

questions.questionText: What is the opposite (antonym) of the word "COURAGE"?
questions.explanation: Lawan kata dari "courage" (keberanian) adalah "fear" (ketakutan) atau "cowardice" (kebengecutan).

questions.questionText: Teacher: "Attention, class! Please open your book to page 15." - Students: "___"
questions.explanation: Respons patuh dan santun saat guru meminta perhatian adalah "Yes, Sir!" atau "Yes, Ma'am!".

questions.questionText: Which expression is used to ask for clarification when you do not hear clearly?
options: Pardon me, could you please repeat that?
questions.explanation: "Pardon me, could you please repeat that?" adalah ungkapan santun meminta pengulangan ucapan.

questions.questionText: Complete the sentence: "We ___ very enthusiastic about studying in the multimedia room."
questions.explanation: Subjek "We" berpasangan dengan to be "are" dalam Simple Present.

questions.questionText: In a Descriptive Text, what is the purpose of the "Identification" section?
options: To introduce and identify the specific person, place, or thing to be described
To state arguments on an issue
questions.explanation: Bagian Identification bertujuan memperkenalkan objek/tokoh yang akan digambarkan.

questions.questionText: Edo: "Thank you so much for lending me your English dictionary." - Budi: "___"
questions.explanation: Respons paling tepat untuk ungkapan terima kasih adalah "You are welcome".

questions.questionText: Identify the adjective in the sentence: "The diligent boy always finishes his English tasks on time."
questions.explanation: "Diligent" (rajin) adalah kata sifat (adjective) yang menerangkan kata benda "boy".

questions.questionText: Before going to bed at 09:30 p.m., what parting expression do you say to your family?
questions.explanation: "Good night" digunakan sebagai salam perpisahan ketika hendak beristirahat tidur malam.

questions.questionText: Which modal verb expresses ability in: "Siti ___ speak English clearly and confidently"?
questions.explanation: Modal "can" digunakan untuk menyatakan kemampuan (ability).

questions.questionText: What is the motto of SI CERDAS ENGLISH?
options: Learn with Confidence, Speak with Courage!
questions.explanation: Moto resmi SI CERDAS ENGLISH adalah "Learn with Confidence, Speak with Courage!".

questions.questionText: Complete the interrogative question: "___ your father go to work by motorcycle every morning?"
questions.explanation: Subjek orang ketiga tunggal "your father" (he) menggunakan kata kerja bantu "Does".

questions.questionText: Which expression shows greeting someone you haven't seen in a long time?
options: Long time no see! How have you been?
Excuse me, where is the canteen?
questions.explanation: "Long time no see!" adalah ungkapan ramah saat bertemu kawan yang sudah lama tidak berjumpa.

questions.questionText: What is the main communicative goal of an Announcement Text in school?
options: To give official information about an event or notice to the school community
To amuse readers with a funny cartoon
To describe the physical traits of a teacher
questions.explanation: Teks pengumuman bertujuan menyampaikan informasi penting secara resmi.

questions.questionText: Arrange the words into a correct order: [always / English songs / listens to / Maya]
options: Maya always listens to English songs.
English songs Maya always listens to.
Listens to Maya always English songs.
Always Maya listens to English songs.
questions.explanation: Pola susunan: Subject (Maya) + Adverb of frequency (always) + Verb (listens to) + Object (English songs).

questions.questionText: Which coordinating conjunction indicates contrast? "He is tired, ___ he keeps practicing speaking."
questions.explanation: "Yet" atau "but" digunakan untuk menghubungkan dua pernyataan yang bertentangan.

questions.questionText: What is the plural form of the irregular noun "tooth"?
questions.explanation: Bentuk jamak tidak beraturan dari "tooth" adalah "teeth".

questions.questionText: What is the generic structure of a Recount Text?
questions.explanation: Struktur teks recount: Orientation (pengenalan), Events (rentetan peristiwa), Reorientation (penutup).

questions.questionText: Select the sentence that correctly uses the Simple Past Tense:
options: We participated in the English speech contest yesterday.
We participate in the English speech contest yesterday.
We are participate in the English speech contest yesterday.
We participating in the English speech contest yesterday.
questions.explanation: Penanda waktu "yesterday" mewajibkan kata kerja bentuk lampau (Verb 2): "participated".

questions.questionText: Choose the correct question tag: "You love speaking English with AI Miss Sarah, ___?"
questions.explanation: Kalimat positif Simple Present dengan kata kerja "love" berpasangan dengan question tag "don't you".

questions.questionText: What are the main components of a Procedure Text?
options: Goal / Aim, Materials / Ingredients, and Steps / Methods
questions.explanation: Komponen teks prosedur terdiri dari Goal (tujuan), Materials (alat/bahan), dan Steps (langkah-langkah).

questions.questionText: Complete: "There ___ a big English laboratory and three computer rooms in our school."
questions.explanation: Ketika frasa kata benda pertama setelah "there" adalah tunggal ("a big English laboratory"), kita menggunakan "There is".

questions.questionText: Choose the correct imperative sentence for giving positive classroom instructions:
questions.explanation: Kalimat perintah (imperative) diawali dengan kata kerja dasar "Speak...".

questions.questionText: Which word is a synonym of "AWESOME" in expressing appreciation?
questions.explanation: "Wonderful" dan "fantastic" adalah sinonim dari kata apresiasi "awesome" (luar biasa).

questions.questionText: When your friend wins the English storytelling contest, what do you say?
options: Congratulations on your great victory! I am proud of you.
I am sorry to hear that.
questions.explanation: "Congratulations on..." adalah ungkapan ucapan selamat atas prestasi seseorang.

questions.questionText: Complete with the superlative adjective: "This is the ___ English quiz I have ever taken."
questions.explanation: Kata sifat dengan lebih dari dua suku kata "interesting" menggunakan awalan "most" dalam bentuk superlative: "the most interesting".

questions.questionText: What does the caution sign "SILENCE, EXAMINATION IN PROGRESS" mean?
options: You must not make any noise because an exam is taking place.
You are allowed to shout loudly.
questions.explanation: Tanda tersebut menginstruksikan pengunjung dan siswa untuk hening karena sedang ada ujian.

questions.questionText: Identify the adverb in the sentence: "Andi answered the English questions easily."
questions.explanation: "Easily" (dengan mudah) adalah adverb of manner yang menerangkan kata kerja "answered".

questions.questionText: Which sentence is written in the Present Continuous Tense?
options: The students are listening to the audio script carefully.
The students listened to the audio script yesterday.
The students listen to the audio script every day.
The students will listen to the audio script.
questions.explanation: Pola "to be (are) + Verb-ing (listening)" menyatakan kejadian yang sedang berlangsung saat ini.

questions.questionText: What is the characteristic resolution in a Narrative Text?
options: The crisis or problem faced by the characters is resolved
The characters are introduced for the first time
The steps of making food are listed
questions.explanation: Tahap Resolution dalam teks naratif adalah saat masalah atau konflik utama berhasil diselesaikan.

questions.questionText: Which sentence shows polite asking for permission from a teacher?
options: May I borrow an English dictionary, Sir?
You have to give me the dictionary.
questions.explanation: "May I...?" adalah bentuk permohonan izin yang paling santun dalam bahasa Inggris.

questions.questionText: Complete the sentence: "You ___ drink more water after doing physical exercise."
questions.explanation: Modal "should" digunakan untuk memberikan anjuran atau saran positif yang bermanfaat.

questions.questionText: Which statement demonstrates an expression of giving an opinion?
options: In my opinion, learning English with interactive AI is very effective.
questions.explanation: "In my opinion, ..." adalah frasa kunci baku untuk mengemukakan pendapat pribadi.

questions.questionText: What is the translation of "DEEP LEARNING: MINDFUL, MEANINGFUL, JOYFUL LEARNING" in Indonesian educational context?
options: Pembelajaran Mendalam: Berkesadaran, Bermakna, dan Menggembirakan
Pembelajaran Cepat: Menghafal, Ujian, dan Nilai
Pembelajaran Rumit: Sulit, Membosankan, dan Menakutkan
Pembelajaran Otomatis: Tanpa Guru dan Siswa
questions.explanation: Tiga pilar Deep Learning Kemendikdasmen adalah Mindful (berkesadaran), Meaningful (bermakna), dan Joyful (menggembirakan).

questions.questionText: Soal Essai 1: Tuliskan satu paragraf perkenalan diri dalam Bahasa Inggris (Self-Introduction) sebanyak 4-6 kalimat. Cantumkan nama lengkap, nama panggilan, umur, kelas, alamat sekolah, dan hobi bahasa Inggrismu.
questions.correctAnswer: Hello everyone! My name is Ahmad Rizky, and you can call me Rizky. I am 13 years old and I study in Grade VII at SMP Negeri 1 Cerdas Bangsa. I live with my family in Bandung. In my free time, I really enjoy speaking English and practicing pronunciation with AI Miss Sarah. Nice to meet you all!
questions.sampleAnswer: Hello everyone! My name is Ahmad Rizky, and you can call me Rizky. I am 13 years old and I study in Grade VII at SMP Negeri 1 Cerdas Bangsa. I live with my family in Bandung. In my free time, I really enjoy speaking English and practicing pronunciation with AI Miss Sarah. Nice to meet you all!
rubricCriteria: Kelengkapan data perkenalan (nama, umur, kelas, hobi)
Kesesuaian tata bahasa Simple Present dan to be
questions.explanation: Rubrik Penilaian: Siswa menuliskan perkenalan terstruktur dengan pembuka, data diri lengkap, serta penutup ramah (Nice to meet you).

questions.questionText: Soal Essai 2: Tuliskan satu paragraf teks deskriptif (Descriptive Text) singkat (4-5 kalimat) tentang guru Bahasa Inggrismu atau teman sekelasmu. Sertakan ciri fisik (appearance) dan sifat positif (personality).
questions.correctAnswer: My favorite English teacher is Miss Sarah. She is tall, has friendly eyes, and always wears a beautiful smile. She is very patient and kind when explaining difficult grammar topics. Miss Sarah always inspires us to speak English with confidence and courage. All students in our class respect and love her.
questions.sampleAnswer: My favorite English teacher is Miss Sarah. She is tall, has friendly eyes, and always wears a beautiful smile. She is very patient and kind when explaining difficult grammar topics. Miss Sarah always inspires us to speak English with confidence and courage. All students in our class respect and love her.
rubricCriteria: Penyebutan ciri fisik dan sifat kepribadian
questions.explanation: Rubrik Penilaian: Menghadirkan identifikasi objek, pendeskripsian ciri fisik, dan sifat kepribadian dengan kata sifat deskriptif.

questions.questionText: Soal Essai 3: Tuliskan 3 pasangan ungkapan salam kesantunan (Greeting) beserta respons jawaban yang tepat dan waktu penggunaannya dalam kehidupan sehari-hari di SMP.
questions.correctAnswer: 1. "Good morning, Sir!" - Respons: "Good morning! Are you ready to learn today?" (Digunakan pukul 06.00 - 12.00 pagi). 2. "Good afternoon, Ma'am!" - Respons: "Good afternoon, students!" (Digunakan pukul 12.00 - 18.00 sore). 3. "Good evening, friends!" - Respons: "Good evening!" (Digunakan setelah pukul 18.00 saat pertemuan malam).
questions.sampleAnswer: 1. "Good morning, Sir!" - Respons: "Good morning! Are you ready to learn today?" (Digunakan pukul 06.00 - 12.00 pagi). 2. "Good afternoon, Ma'am!" - Respons: "Good afternoon, students!" (Digunakan pukul 12.00 - 18.00 sore). 3. "Good evening, friends!" - Respons: "Good evening!" (Digunakan setelah pukul 18.00 saat pertemuan malam).
questions.explanation: Rubrik Penilaian: Menyajikan 3 pasangan salam santun lengkap dengan respons dan kejelasan waktu penggunaannya.

questions.questionText: Soal Essai 4: Jelaskan secara ringkas perbedaan penggunaan preposisi tempat "in", "on", dan "at" dalam Bahasa Inggris, serta berikan masing-masing 1 contoh kalimat lengkap!
questions.correctAnswer: Preposisi "in" digunakan untuk area geografis umum yang luas seperti kota atau negara (Contoh: "I live in Jakarta"). Preposisi "on" digunakan untuk nama jalan atau lantai gedung (Contoh: "The bookstore is on Merdeka Street"). Preposisi "at" digunakan untuk alamat spesifik bernomor rumah atau lokasi pinpoint tertentu (Contoh: "We study at SMP Negeri 1 on Melati Street No. 10").
questions.sampleAnswer: Preposisi "in" digunakan untuk area geografis umum yang luas seperti kota atau negara (Contoh: "I live in Jakarta"). Preposisi "on" digunakan untuk nama jalan atau lantai gedung (Contoh: "The bookstore is on Merdeka Street"). Preposisi "at" digunakan untuk alamat spesifik bernomor rumah atau lokasi pinpoint tertentu (Contoh: "We study at SMP Negeri 1 on Melati Street No. 10").
rubricCriteria: Pemahaman konsep gradasi in -> on -> at
questions.explanation: Rubrik Penilaian: Menjelaskan perbedaan tingkat spesifikasi tempat: "in" (kota/negara), "on" (jalan), "at" (alamat spesifik bernomor).

questions.questionText: Soal Essai 5: Tuliskan satu paragraf Recount Text (4-5 kalimat) tentang aktivitas liburan akhir pekan lalu. Gunakan kata kerja bentuk lampau (Past Tense Verb 2) dengan benar.
questions.correctAnswer: Last Sunday was a wonderful day for me. In the morning, I woke up early and helped my mother clean our living room. After that, I rode my bicycle to the city park with my best friend Andi. In the afternoon, we practiced speaking English and completed an evaluation quiz on the SI CERDAS app. I went to sleep at night feeling very happy and fulfilled.
questions.sampleAnswer: Last Sunday was a wonderful day for me. In the morning, I woke up early and helped my mother clean our living room. After that, I rode my bicycle to the city park with my best friend Andi. In the afternoon, we practiced speaking English and completed an evaluation quiz on the SI CERDAS app. I went to sleep at night feeling very happy and fulfilled.
rubricCriteria: Konsistensi kata kerja Verb 2 (woke, helped, rode, practiced, went)
questions.explanation: Rubrik Penilaian: Menuliskan runtutan pengalaman masa lalu dengan menggunakan kata kerja Verb 2 dan penanda waktu yang logis.

questions.questionText: Soal Essai 6: Buatlah teks dialog percakapan antara dua siswa (Student A dan Student B) yang saling bertanya tentang hobi kegemaran masing-masing (minimal 6 giliran bicara / 6 baris kalimat).
questions.correctAnswer:
Student A: "Hello Siti, what do you like to do in your leisure time?"
Student B: "Hi Rian! My favorite hobby is reading English comic stories and listening to pop music. How about you?"
Student A: "I really love playing basketball with our school club every Tuesday."
Student B: "That sounds very active and healthy! How long have you played basketball?"
Student A: "I have played for about two years. It gives me high energy and spirit."
Student B: "Awesome! Let us always enjoy our positive hobbies."

Student A: "Hello Siti, what do you like to do in your leisure time?"
Student B: "Hi Rian! My favorite hobby is reading English comic stories and listening to pop music. How about you?"
Student A: "I really love playing basketball with our school club every Tuesday."
Student B: "That sounds very active and healthy! How long have you played basketball?"
Student A: "I have played for about two years. It gives me high energy and spirit."
Student B: "Awesome! Let us always enjoy our positive hobbies."
rubricCriteria: Format dialog minimal 6 baris pergantian bicara
Pola tanya-jawab mengenai hobi yang runtut
questions.explanation: Rubrik Penilaian: Dialog komunikatif dua arah mengenai hobi dengan kosakata yang relevan dan santun.

questions.questionText: Soal Essai 7: Berikan 3 saran konkret dalam Bahasa Inggris untuk teman sekelasmu agar tidak merasa cemas atau malu saat berbicara Bahasa Inggris (sesuai semangat "Learn with Confidence, Speak with Courage!").
questions.correctAnswer: 1. Practice speaking aloud in front of a mirror or with AI Miss Sarah every single day without being afraid of making grammar mistakes. 2. Memorize and practice 3 to 5 new English words daily by using them directly in daily conversations with your classmates. 3. Always believe in yourself and remember that making mistakes is the natural stepping stone to mastering English fluently!
questions.sampleAnswer: 1. Practice speaking aloud in front of a mirror or with AI Miss Sarah every single day without being afraid of making grammar mistakes. 2. Memorize and practice 3 to 5 new English words daily by using them directly in daily conversations with your classmates. 3. Always believe in yourself and remember that making mistakes is the natural stepping stone to mastering English fluently!
rubricCriteria: 3 poin saran yang konkret dan memotivasi
questions.explanation: Rubrik Penilaian: Menyajikan 3 rekomendasi aplikatif untuk menumbuhkan rasa percaya diri berkomunikasi lisan.

questions.questionText: Soal Essai 8: Susunlah teks prosedur (Procedure Text) singkat berjudul "How to Use SI CERDAS ENGLISH to Improve English Skills" yang memuat Goal, Materials, dan 4 Langkah Berurutan (Steps).
questions.correctAnswer:
Goal: How to Use SI CERDAS ENGLISH to Improve English Skills.
Materials: Smartphone / Computer, Internet connection, and Headset.
Steps:
1. First, launch the SI CERDAS ENGLISH application and choose your grade level.
2. Second, expand your active vocabulary through the Vocabulary Builder and practice accurate pronunciation.
3. Third, enter the AI Speaking Partner to have a cheerful 5-minute conversation with Miss Sarah.
4. Finally, complete the daily evaluation quiz to measure your learning progress.

rubricCriteria: Kelengkapan struktur teks prosedur (Goal, Materials, Steps)
Penggunaan kata urutan waktu (First, Second, Third, Finally)
questions.explanation: Rubrik Penilaian: Teks prosedur terstruktur runtut dengan tujuan, bahan, serta 4 langkah aksi yang jelas.

questions.questionText: Soal Essai 9: Mengapa penguasaan Bahasa Inggris sangat penting bagi masa depan siswa SMP di era teknologi saat ini? Tuliskan pendapatmu dalam 4-5 kalimat berbahasa Inggris dengan alasan yang logis.
questions.correctAnswer: Mastering English is extremely crucial for junior high school students today. Firstly, English is the primary international language that allows us to communicate with global communities. Secondly, the majority of world knowledge, digital educational tools, and scientific literature are written in English. Furthermore, strong English proficiency will open countless scholarships and career opportunities in the future. Therefore, learning English empowers us to achieve our highest ambitions.
questions.sampleAnswer: Mastering English is extremely crucial for junior high school students today. Firstly, English is the primary international language that allows us to communicate with global communities. Secondly, the majority of world knowledge, digital educational tools, and scientific literature are written in English. Furthermore, strong English proficiency will open countless scholarships and career opportunities in the future. Therefore, learning English empowers us to achieve our highest ambitions.
questions.explanation: Rubrik Penilaian: Mengemukakan argumentasi logis mengenai pentingnya bahasa Inggris dengan kata penghubung penalaran.

questions.questionText: Soal Essai 10: Buatlah teks undangan resmi singkat (Invitation Message) dari panitia kelas kepada Kepala Sekolah dan Guru untuk menghadiri acara "English Day & Speech Competition" di sekolahmu.

descriptors.level4: Berbicara lancar tanpa jeda panjang, intonasi wajar dan percaya diri.

descriptors.level2: Sering berhenti atau terdiam cukup lama untuk mengingat kata.
descriptors.level1: Sangat terbata-bata dan membutuhkan dorongan berulang kali.

descriptors.level4: Pengucapan kata jelas, artikulasi tepat, aksen mudah dipahami.
descriptors.level3: Pengucapan sebagian besar tepat, sedikit kesalahan yang tidak mengganggu makna.
descriptors.level2: Beberapa kesalahan pengucapan yang membuat lawan bicara harus mengulang.
descriptors.level1: Banyak pengucapan keliru sehingga makna sulit dipahami.

descriptors.level4: Kosakata variatif, tepat sasaran sesuai topik SMP dan natural.
descriptors.level3: Kosakata memadai untuk kebutuhan percakapan dasar sehari-hari.
descriptors.level2: Kosakata sangat terbatas, sering mengulang kata yang sama.
descriptors.level1: Kosakata tidak mencukupi untuk menyampaikan pesan.

descriptors.level4: Struktur kalimat dasar benar (Simple Present, to be, kata ganti subjek).
descriptors.level3: Ada kesalahan tata bahasa kecil yang masih dapat dimaklumi dan tidak mengubah pesan.
descriptors.level2: Kesalahan tata bahasa cukup sering terjadi (misal to be tertukar).
descriptors.level1: Tata bahasa membingungkan dan tidak beraturan.

descriptors.level4: Merespons pertanyaan AI/lawan bicara secara spontan dan kontekstual.
descriptors.level3: Merespons dengan baik setelah mencerna pertanyaan.
descriptors.level2: Respons lambat dan memerlukan petunjuk kalimat (hint).
descriptors.level1: Sulit merespons meski telah diberikan petunjuk.

descriptors.level4: Isi tulisan sangat lengkap, menjawab seluruh pertanyaan panduan dengan detail.
descriptors.level3: Isi tulisan relevan dan menjawab sebagian besar panduan.
descriptors.level2: Isi tulisan kurang lengkap dan hanya membahas sebagian kecil instruksi.
descriptors.level1: Isi tulisan keluar dari topik yang ditugaskan.

descriptors.level4: Penggunaan tenses, kata kerja, dan to be sangat rapi dan konsisten.

descriptors.level2: Banyak kesalahan tata bahasa dasar yang perlu perbaikan.
descriptors.level1: Kesalahan tata bahasa mendominasi sehingga sulit dimengerti.

descriptors.level4: Pilihan kata kaya, sesuai konteks SMP, dan ejaan tepat.
descriptors.level3: Pilihan kata memadai untuk menyampaikan maksud.
descriptors.level1: Banyak kata yang tidak tepat arti atau terjemahan harfiah salah.

descriptors.level4: Paragraf tersusun rapi dengan kalimat pembuka, isi, dan penutup yang jelas.
descriptors.level3: Alur kalimat cukup runtut dan mudah diikuti pembaca.
descriptors.level1: Tidak memiliki struktur paragraf yang teratur.

descriptors.level4: Huruf kapital, titik, koma, dan ejaan kata digunakan dengan benar.
descriptors.level3: Sedikit kesalahan penulisan huruf kapital atau ejaan kata.
descriptors.level2: Cukup banyak salah eja (typo) dan tanda baca yang hilang.

descriptors.level3: Memahami sebagian besar arti kata dalam teks.

lessonPlans.title: Modul Ajar Bahasa Inggris Kelas VII: Introducing Yourself and Greetings
lessonPlans.subject: Bahasa Inggris
lessonPlans.specialNeedsNotes: Dukungan tombol "Explain in Indonesian" dan teks alternatif bagi siswa dengan kecepatan belajar adaptif.
tujuanPembelajaran: Peserta didik mampu mengidentifikasi fungsi sosial dan ungkapan sapaan (greetings) serta perkenalan diri dengan benar.
Peserta didik mampu menyusun kalimat perkenalan diri sederhana mencakup nama, usia, alamat, dan hobi.
Peserta didik memiliki keberanian memperagakan percakapan perkenalan diri menggunakan AI Speaking Partner dengan percaya diri.
kegiatanPendahuluan: Guru menyapa peserta didik dengan salam Bahasa Inggris ceria: "Good morning, class! How are you today?"
Apersepsi: Guru menampilkan video pendek siswa menyapa teman baru di sekolah.
Guru menyampaikan tujuan pembelajaran dan mengaitkannya dengan tagline: "Learn with Confidence, Speak with Courage!".
kegiatanInti: Tahap 1 (Orientasi): Siswa membuka aplikasi SI CERDAS ENGLISH pada Modul Demonstrasi Kelas VII.
Tahap 2 (Eksplorasi): Siswa mendengarkan contoh audio pelafalan salam dan memperkenalkan diri.
Tahap 3 (Praktik Terbimbing): Siswa mencoba percakapan interaktif dengan AI Speaking Partner tingkat Beginner.
Tahap 4 (Diferensiasi): Siswa yang membutuhkan panduan menggunakan tombol "Give Me a Hint", sedangkan siswa yang mahir mencoba memperluas topik.
Tahap 5 (Unjuk Kerja): Siswa secara berpasangan mempraktikkan dialog perkenalan diri di depan kelas.
kegiatanPenutup: Refleksi bersama: Siswa menyampaikan kosakata baru yang dipelajari hari ini.
Guru memberikan umpan balik positif atas keberanian siswa berbicara.
Penutup dengan salam: "Thank you for your active participation. See you next meeting!"
mediaDanSumber: Platform SI CERDAS ENGLISH (Fitur Speaking Partner, Vocabulary Builder, Pronunciation)
Buku Teks Bahasa Inggris SMP Kelas VII Kemendikbudristek
aktivitasSiswa: Mencocokkan kosakata baru di Vocabulary Builder
Berlatih percakapan lisan 5 giliran bersama AI Speaking Partner

asesmen.diagnostik: Pre-Test 5 butir soal di awal bab untuk mengukur pengetahuan dasar.
asesmen.formatif: Observasi keaktifan percakapan dengan AI Speaking Partner dan kuis kosakata interaktif.
asesmen.sumatif: Post-test tertulis dan penilaian unjuk kerja berbicara (speaking rubric).

lessonPlans.rubrikPenilaian: Menggunakan Rubrik Keterampilan Berbicara SI CERDAS ENGLISH (Fluency 20%, Pronunciation 25%, Vocabulary 20%, Grammar 20%, Interaction 15%).
lessonPlans.refleksiPembelajaran: Apakah seluruh siswa berani berbicara minimal satu kalimat perkenalan dalam Bahasa Inggris? Jika ada siswa pemalu, fasilitasi dengan latihan mandiri bersama AI terlebih dahulu sebelum tampil di hadapan teman.
